title: Estimating the Standing Long Jump Length from Smartphone Inertial Sensors through Machine Learning Algorithms
summary: In 114 participants, the model was evaluated against measured jump length using held-out test RMSE. This is a bounded measurement study and does not establish performance across devices, populations or athletic settings.
ai_technology: Lasso-selected inertial features from smartphone sensors feed Gaussian-process regression to estimate standing long-jump distance.
